description: This is a CMake find module script designed to locate and configure the bcm_host library for use in a project, particularly for Raspberry Pi platform. It checks for the library's presence via pkg-config or directly through find_library, and sets up an imported target for the library with appropriate properties.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Locates and loads CMake configuration for a package.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the presence of specified pkg-config modules.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds a library and sets a variable with its path.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes and executes another CMake script.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles required and optional components for a package.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced so they are hidden in GUIs unless requested.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates an imported or interface library target.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for a target, such as location, compile options, etc.
